stemMd: Which formula contains an ester linkage?
explanationMd: An ester contains a carbonyl carbon attached to an oxygen that is attached to another carbon group. CH3COOCH3 has this arrangement, distinguishing it from ketones, alcohols and aldehydes.

distractorRationale.c: This is a ketone, lacking the carbonyl–oxygen–carbon linkage.
